DECLARE		@DT_F	DATETIME,
			@DT_T	DATETIME

SET @DT_F  = CONVERT(CHAR(6), DATEADD(m, -15, GETDATE()), 112) + '01'
SET @DT_T  = GETDATE()

IF OBJECT_ID('tempdb..##reportingperiod') IS NOT NULL DROP TABLE ##reportingperiod

CREATE TABLE ##reportingperiod
(START_DT DATETIME)

INSERT INTO ##reportingperiod
SELECT START_DT 
FROM REPORTS.reporting_periods (@DT_F, @DT_T, 0)
ORDER BY START_DT DESC

SELECT * FROM ##reportingperiod

SET @ST_S	= GETDATE()
SET @TS_S	= GETDATE()
SET @PR_S	= GETDATE()

EXEC STAGING.LOG_EVENT 1, 2, 4, @ROWS, 'CLM FAC. Delete Information from CLAIMS_INVENTORY table',	@ST_S,	@TS_S, @PR_S
	SET @ST_S	= GETDATE()
	SET @ROWS	= 0

	SET @ST_S	= GETDATE()
